DeterminationBasis: Existing T08 controls establish determination/execution separation, lifecycle preservation, bypass handling, ambiguity handling and chain-boundary recording. T09-001 and related gate controls establish that later mandatory execution predicates remain independently required. However, no existing abstract test directly establishes the normative semantics of ALLOW itself: that ALLOW permits bounded progression within the declared governance scope while not constituting authority to skip later execution predicates. That positive and negative ALLOW semantic boundary remains a distinct test obligation.

T12-006 directly exercises an existing receipt-identifier collision and requires refusal, a separately identifiable successor where explicitly allowed, or explicit conflict handling without alteration of the predecessor. T12-002 establishes successor-receipt preservation and T12-005 establishes correction-forward receipt preservation. Together these existing tests cover refusal or explicit successor/correction handling while prohibiting silent overwrite of the predecessor.
